sources.citation: Ercsey-Ravasz & Toroczkai, Optimization hardness as transient chaos in an analog approach to constraint satisfaction, Nature Physics 7, 966-970 (2011)
sources.firewall: The paper reports polynomial continuous time for its analog dynamics at the expense of exponential fluctuations in an energy function; this is not a polynomial-time digital SAT algorithm.

sources.citation: Molnar et al., A continuous-time MaxSAT solver with high analog performance, Nature Communications 9, 4864 (2018)
sources.firewall: Performance of an analog dynamical system does not establish classical digital polynomial complexity.

nonimports: No Lyapunov exponent theorem is imported into the discrete proof-state system.
No chaos-based SAT solver is used.
No physical/analog resource model is used as P-vs-NP evidence.
Janus_use: Use chaos vocabulary only as inspiration for measuring collapse/divergence of proof-relevant normalized interface states.
